title: ertkit: resistivity inversion for groundwater exploration, with uncertainty and depth of investigation
description: ertkit is a Python package for inverting vertical electrical sounding (VES) data for groundwater exploration; 2.5-D electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) follows in later releases. Each result states what the data can resolve: a data error model and a fit to the noise level, linearized parameter uncertainty, sensitivity and a depth of investigation. Every release publishes a verification report generated by its test suite.
